_about: Chapter 6 (Travel): Andrés rents the learner a car: the reservation or a walk-in's car size, the license, passport and credit card, an upgrade (twist: a free one), the twist of the mandatory liability insurance left out online, full coverage, the deposit hold, the full tank, a GPS or child seat, the return day, signing, the keys.

items.prompt: Andrés, the rental agent, stands behind the counter about one third from the left, both hands resting on the counter, leaning in a little with a confident smile as the learner walks up ("¡Siguiente, por favor! ¿Tiene reservación?").
Change only his pose and expression: he holds an open brochure toward the learner showing pictures of four cars from small to big (no text, no prices), eyebrows raised (what kind of car?).

Change only his pose and expression: he holds out one open hand, palm up, across the counter, waiting for the learner's driver's license, passport and credit card, with a friendly, businesslike smile.
Change only his pose and expression: he taps the picture of a bigger, midsize car in the open brochure with one finger, leaning in with a salesman's grin, eyebrows raised (a bigger car?).

Change only his pose and expression: he turns a printed sheet toward the learner (blank, only gray lines and a small shield icon), one finger on one line, with an apologetic, sympathetic grimace (the online price left out the mandatory insurance).

Change only his pose and expression: he lays a leaflet flat on the counter with two simple icons side by side, a small shield and a big shield over a little car (no text), and points at the big shield, eyebrows raised (full coverage?).
Change only his pose and expression: he holds a plain teal credit card (blank: no numbers, no logos) to a card terminal with a blank screen on the counter, explaining the hold with a calm smile.

Change only his pose and expression: he holds up a small blank card printed only with a simple fuel-gauge icon, the needle on full, and points at it, eyebrows raised (bring it back with a full tank?).

Change only his pose and expression: he sets a small GPS unit with a blank screen on the counter and gestures toward a child car seat standing beside the counter, eyebrows raised (a GPS or a child seat?).
Change only his pose and expression: he holds up a small desk calendar with a blank grid of empty squares (no numbers, no words), one fingertip on a square near the end of the week (the return day).

Change only his pose and expression: he slides a rental contract (blank, only gray lines and two empty signature lines) across the counter toward the learner, a pen lying on it, and points to the bottom of the page.
Change only his pose and expression: he holds out a car key on a ring with a plain teal tag (no text), dangling it toward the learner with a big, confident smile.
